paragraphs.text: Shokol Wenslauv was the skyjek Air Commander of the Tenth Leaguehall on Ravnica .
Shokol Wenslauv fought in the battle of Centerfort during the Decamillennial , where she was brought to ground in a crash by the Golgari general Ludmilla .

Despite her crash, Shokol survived, and twelve years later, she was the skyjek who boarded the silent decks of Parhelion after its return from Agyrem . There, she witnessed firsthand the Parhelion's crash into Prahv . She was gravely injured in the crash, and likely would have died, but Agrus Kos 's ghost used her body as a spirit-host, and noticed she carried a teardrop which he used to heal her. Her grounder allowed Kos to capture Szadek's ghost and later launch it to Augustin IV , causing another guildmaster's death when the Parhelion exploded overhead. Shokol survived this blast as well, and her actions afterwards are unknown.
